rows.corpus_definition: To often do a particular thing or have a habit.
rows.example_en: I tend to wake up very early.

rows.corpus_definition: Feeling worried and unable to relax.
rows.example_en: The atmosphere in the room was very tense.
You did a terrific job on the project.
The child was terrified of the dark room.

rows.corpus_definition: A large area of land owned by a country.
rows.example_en: The animal protects its territory from others.

rows.corpus_definition: The way that something feels when you touch it.
rows.example_en: I like the smooth texture of this silk fabric.

rows.corpus_definition: An idea that explains why something happens.
rows.example_en: That is just an interesting theory.

rows.corpus_definition: A special chair used by a king or queen.
rows.example_en: The king sat on his golden throne.

rows.corpus_definition: The regular rise and fall of the sea level.
rows.example_en: The tide is coming in very quickly now.

rows.corpus_definition: A powerful wind that spins and moves across the ground.
rows.example_en: The tornado caused much damage to the town.
